pm2.environment: Linux Node 24 + actual PM2 6.0.14; mock HTTP backend
checks: PM2 starts daemon and daemon performs outbound heartbeat and claim
PM2 restart starts a new daemon and recovers private configuration
Graceful PM2 stop releases process/lock without killing unrelated PM2 applications
Two online rooms, two humans + three bots each; all six personas
SQL scheduling actor matches production JS for auction, starting, rent, card, trade, debt, mortgage, buildOffer
Single-use pairing, RLS wake isolation, privileged RPC denial, old Edge claim fenced
Concurrent SQL claims: one lease per room and scope enforced
Atomic room/action/worker receipt; lost ACK replay has one effect
Expired lease rejects stale action and is recoverable without browser wake
180 online scheduling iterations, real model decisions, intensive auctions, N5 bid grid
Worker revoke stops claims and hint access without changing game state
limits: Isolated PostgreSQL; not hosted Supabase Auth/Realtime.
